name: Leverage Shares -1x Salesforce.Com ETC
summary: Leverage Shares -1x Salesforce.Com ETC is an exchange-traded product (ETP) designed to provide investors with a -1x (inverse) leveraged exposure to the daily performance of Salesforce.com stock. It allows investors to potentially profit from a decline in the value of Salesforce.com. The ETP is issued by Leverage Shares Public Limited, based in the United Kingdom.
